notes.title: Gameplay from the developers
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome[/h1]
Action & Adventure in a Physicalized World

Dive into the captivating realm of Cardboard Fish and you'll be treated to an exclusive showcase of the Cardboard Fish one-of-a-kind world. Witness the unveiling of unique gameplay and mechanics that set this game apart. Delve into the complexities of the environment and observe how creative problem-solving serves as the key to helping our hero fish Nozzle to escape the Professor's makeshift testing lab. The developers invite you to explore the innovative features that make Cardboard Fish a truly exceptional gaming experience.

What are we demonstrating and discussing
Gameplay
Levels
Mechanics
Puzzles
Story

[url=store.steampowered.com] https://www.cardboardfish.com.au [/url]

notes.content:
Nozzle can now swim backwards
Options setting for inverting up/down movement
Improved tank depth guides, can be turned off in options
Camera speed increased
